items.question: What mantra formula is prescribed for ritual placement on the head?
premises: The verse specifies a ritual placement on the head.
A particular mantra phrase is designated for this placement.
The phrase is expressed as the formula sūkṣmākārāya agnivadhū iti.
items.inference: Therefore the head is to be consecrated with the mantra formula sūkṣmākārāyāgnivadhū iti.
uncertainties: The internal segmentation of the fused mantra token follows conventional sandhi resolution but is not split in the surface.
items.plain_english: With the mantra 'sūkṣmākārāya agnivadhū iti', one should consecrate the head.
